title: Lumbar Spine MRI Coverage Policy
source: Synthetic research fixture; not an authoritative payer policy
narrative: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) of the lumbar spine is medically indicated when radicular symptoms are present and conservative management has failed for a minimum of 6 continuous weeks.

requirements.description: Documented lumbar radiculopathy or sciatica symptoms
requirements.rationale: Imaging is indicated only when radicular pain patterns suggest nerve root impingement.

requirements.description: At least 6 weeks of conservative management (e.g. physical therapy)
requirements.rationale: Most uncomplicated back pain resolves within 6 weeks without advanced imaging.
